abstract: Maintains toll distillation pricing schedules and agreed unit processing tariffs
system_message:
You are the Commercial finance director (FIN), responsible for maintaining toll distillation pricing schedules and agreed unit processing tariffs across candidate distillation plants.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Settlement terms（CREDIT）
information_points.content:
FIN-CREDIT-J90：For the High-pressure azeotropic distillation complex, the invoicing credit period under standard processing contracts is 60 days from bill of lading issuance.
FIN-CREDIT-FV0：For the Rotary vacuum thin-film evaporator facility, the invoicing credit period under standard processing contracts is 30 days from bill of lading issuance.
FIN-CREDIT-WJU：For the Fractional vacuum packed-column distillation plant, the invoicing credit period under standard processing contracts is 45 days from bill of lading issuance.

information_points.title: Maintains toll distillation pricing schedules and agreed unit processing tariffs（FEE）
information_points.content:
FIN-FEE-M7V：For the High-pressure azeotropic distillation complex, the unit distillation fee is 350 EUR/t on a tax inclusion basis of excluding statutory VAT.
FIN-FEE-084：For the Fractional vacuum packed-column distillation plant, the unit distillation fee is 300 EUR/t on a tax inclusion basis of excluding statutory VAT.
FIN-FEE-Q3W：For the Rotary vacuum thin-film evaporator facility, the unit distillation fee is 250 EUR/t on a tax inclusion basis of including statutory VAT.
FIN-FEE-79W：For the Rotary vacuum thin-film evaporator facility, the unit distillation fee is 300 EUR/t on a tax inclusion basis of excluding statutory VAT.
